use_cases.description: A customer completes the final part of the quote-and-buy flow by submitting mock payment details for the quoted premium and, on successful payment only, receiving an issued policy number and confirmation of the final premium paid; the purchase stays inside the same uninterrupted guided journey as quoting, uses a mock payment step rather than real payment processing in this version, and must never show or generate the policy number before payment succeeds.

use_cases.title: Get an auto insurance quote
use_cases.description: A customer obtains an auto insurance quote by entering one primary driver's age and driving experience plus one vehicle's make, model, year, value, and registration number, selecting exactly one coverage tier and any allowed add-ons, and reviewing a calculated premium with a breakdown before payment; the guided flow is completed in order but lets the customer go back and change earlier inputs, recalculates the premium when inputs change, and enforces quote eligibility and validation rules including required fields, registration-format checks, Zero Depreciation only with Comprehensive, Comprehensive only when vehicle value is greater than $0, discount limits, and the final premium floor.
use_cases.summary: Enter driver and vehicle details to receive a priced quote.
use_cases.value: Gives the customer a transparent, accurate price so they can decide whether to buy online.
